site.title: SUACI — Outdoor Recovery Skincare
site.description: Instant skin recovery right after outdoor activities. SUACI official website.

brandStory.subtitle: WHY WE STARTED
brandStory.title:
Outside, your skin
was always on its own
brandStory.p1: Walking to work, strolling through the park, spending the day outdoors. The moment you step outside, your skin is exposed to UV rays, dry air, and dust.
brandStory.p2: But there was no product that could hydrate your skin right then and there. Sunscreen is for before you leave. Skincare is for when you get home. Outside, there was nothing you could do for your skin.
brandStory.p3: In a multi-billion dollar skincare market, the category of instant outdoor hydration simply didn't exist.
brandStory.p4: So we built it. Something you can pull out and use anytime, anywhere. That's how SUACI started.

product.subtitle: OUTDOOR RECOVERY
product.name: Instant Cooling Mist
product.benefit1Desc: Instantly lowers elevated skin surface temperature after activity
product.benefit2Desc: Calms inflammatory responses from UV, sweat, and dust exposure
product.benefit3Desc: Rapidly replenishes moisture to damaged skin barrier
